name: exact-gate-residual-lumps
title: Diagnose the residual exact-gate host lumps and the health-signal race
description: Part 2 of the operator's 'fix all suspicious tests' item. After 09-30-test-flake-and-hang-stabilization removed the tiering family from the exact allocation gates (host contract TieredCompilation=false; the affected class now runs 100/100 green with zero full-suite failures), the full suite still fails roughly 1 run in 8: a once-per-process host-level lump (observed 168 / 1880 / 5216 / 7364 / 7384 / 7448 / 8008 B) lands inside a measured window of CapturePumpReadCallTests.CountingReaderIdleIterationsAllocateNoManagedBytes or SweepAllocationGateTests.FlowTableSweepAllocatesNoManagedBytes, and LayeredCaptureRunnerHealthSignalTests.FailureThresholdForcesARefreshDespiteIdenticalEnumeration fails with consecutive '0' against an expected '1'. Until both are understood, no exact allocation gate can be proven stable at suite level.
creator: qmazon
